quart.en: I want a quart of milk.

quit.en: Tom told Mary that she should quit pretending to be intoxicated.
quit.zh: 汤姆告诉玛丽她应该停止假装醉酒。

quarrel.en: Every time they meet, they quarrel.

quiz.en: We had a history quiz this morning.
quiz.zh: 我们今天早上有历史小考。

queen.en: Queen Elizabeth I passed away in 1603.
queen.zh: 女王伊丽莎白一世于1603年去世。

quality.en: I'd gladly pay more for something if it's of high quality.
quality.zh: 如果它是高品质的东西我会很乐意多付一点钱。

quantity.en: In general, consumers prefer quantity to quality.
quantity.zh: 一般来说，消费者喜欢数量胜于质量。
